jobs.occupation: Assistant(e) RH Zone Europe F/H
jobs.description:
PROPELLING INNOVATION WITH YOU!!!!  
  
 Would you like to join one of the best specialized PLM consulting and system integration firm that works closely with its clients to accelerate business transformation using its unique approach based in product lifecycle management (PLM) - which combines consulting, integration and managed services?  
  
 If yes, this position is for YOU!!!  
  
 As part of our current growth, we are looking for an HR assistant for Europe Zone
 

Job Description
 
 

• Work with lead HR Europe, based in France (Paris), to manage all cross countries HR processes and provide operational & administrative support  
 

• Countries: France, UK, Belgium, Netherlands, Sweden 

• Consolidate the Performance Management cycle data at Europe level – Build & contribute to run all the related HR plans (annual assessment interviews, salary reviews, development plans, training plans)  

• Prepare all appropriate HR documents such as letter, employment contracts and ad hoc correspondences  

• Support the HR Personal administration tasks and lead some of the processes with external partners / providers (payroll coordination, follow up on fringe benefits, individual files,…) and maintain all the HR tracking database (Training plan, work permits, medical checkup, Health Insurance registration, Paid leaves….) 

• Support and run the onboarding process for new comers in the countries  

• Ensure the Processia HR academy regular follow up (eLearning platform) and propose appropriate communication to promote the content 

• Contribute to some HR transversal initiatives and team projects  

The Successful Applicant
 
 

• Job Skills  
 

• At least 3 years of relevant experience in HR in France, UK, Belgium or Netherlands. Ideally familiar with French social legislation 

• Small and fast-paced environment/companies first experience (“PME”) 

• Strong computer skills (Excel and Powerpoint as a must).  

• Fluent French and English, good knowledge of Dutch would be a plus   

·
 Behavioral skills: 
 

- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, ability to build solid relationships with employees, positive open attitude, team spirit.
 

- Autonomy, willingness and ability to work remotely
 

- Flexibility to deal with last minute changes, can-do attitude, problem solver, ability to remain calm under pressure

Connaissance Générales et Ressources Humaines

jobs.occupation: Cook Industrial Kitchen - Aalter - 2 Shifts
jobs.description:
Vol-au-vent, tomato soup with meatballs, or the perfectly cooked roast beef: dishes that make your mouth water. In this role, you help make sure others can enjoy them too. In our kitchen, we produce preparations that would make grandmothers jealous, but on an industrial scale and in large quantities.

We are looking for a Cook in the Aalter region! 
What are your responsibilities? 
• Hygiene is essential for any kitchen employee. That is why you ensure every day that your working methods and finished products comply with all applicable standards.
• You strictly follow all safety regulations. You do everything possible to guarantee both quality and safety. 

Who are you?
• You have experience as a cook in a large-scale catering kitchen or an industrial kitchen. Experience in a production environment is a plus.
• You are able and willing to work in a rotating two-shift system. 
• The early shift starts at 4:30 AM and ends at 12:30 PM.
• The late shift starts at 12:45 PM and ends at 8:00 PM. 
• Team player – You are friendly, enthusiastic, and enjoy working with others. Helping colleagues comes naturally to you.
• Hands-on – You are proactive, enjoy rolling up your sleeves, and have strong practical insight.
• Flexible – You like working as part of a team but can also work independently. In addition, you enjoy the variety of working with different products and tasks.
• Communicative – You have good communication skills and a good command of Dutch and/or English.

• Good numerical skills

• Flexibility

jobs.occupation: Field Service Engineer EMEA
jobs.description:
As a 
field service engineer, you'll be the technical expert customers rely on to keep their industrial equipment running smoothly.
 

You'll work both 
on-site at customer facilities across the EMEA region and 
at the technical service center in Merchtem, combining hands-on troubleshooting, maintenance, and repairs with direct customer support.
 

Your responsibilities will include:
 
 

• Technical troubleshooting: Diagnose, analyze, and resolve issues with industrial measurement equipment, electronic systems, and process control technologies. 

• Installation & commissioning: Install, configure, and commission advanced technical equipment at customer sites throughout the EMEA region. 

• Maintenance & repairs: Perform technical repairs, preventive maintenance, and failure analysis, both on-site and at the workshop in Merchtem. 

• Customer support: Provide professional technical assistance, both remotely and in person, ensuring customers receive efficient and reliable solutions. 

• Technical training: Guide customers in the correct use, maintenance, and operation of their equipment. 

• Continuous improvement: Collaborate with international engineering and technical teams to identify recurring issues and contribute to product and service improvements. 

• Reporting & follow-up: Document technical interventions, maintain accurate service records, and take ownership of your assigned cases from start to finish.  

You'll spend approximately 
40–50% of your time travelling internationally, while the remaining time will mainly be dedicated to technical repairs, diagnostics, and support activities at the Merchtem service center.

What makes you a great match?
 
 

• You are 
fluent in Dutch, French, English, and German, allowing you to communicate confidently with customers and colleagues across the EMEA region. 

• You have a solid understanding of 
electrical systems, industrial electronics, and wiring. 

• You have hands-on experience in 
troubleshooting and repairing industrial electronics or control systems. 

• Ideally, you have at least 
2 years of experience in field service, industrial maintenance, or a manufacturing environment. 

• Experience with 
measurement equipment, process control systems, or industrial communication protocols (Modbus, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, and PROFIBUS) is a strong advantage. 

• You're 
independent, proactive, and reliable, taking full ownership of your tasks and following through on your commitments. 

• You're 
customer-oriented and communicative, keeping customers and colleagues informed throughout the process. 

• You're comfortable working with 
targets, KPIs, and service deadlines while maintaining high-quality standards. 

• You're flexible and enthusiastic about 
international travel (approximately 50%), including overnight stays across the EMEA region. 

• You hold a 
valid driver's license and have a clean driving record.
